proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_advantage spell-scoped saving-throw filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can express advantage on saving throws in general, but it cannot narrow that rider to saving throws against spells only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While wearing this ring, you have Advantage on saving throws against spells.

proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.succeeds_on_qualifying_spell_save
proposed_widenings.justification: The reflection rider depends on succeeding on a save against a spell with additional constraints on spell level, target cardinality, and absence of an area of effect. Existing reaction triggers cannot express that window.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you succeed on the save for a spell of level 7 or lower, the spell has no effect on you. If that spell targeted only you and didn't create an area of effect, you can take a Reaction to deflect the spell back at the spell's caster; the caster must make a saving throw against the spell using their own spell save DC.

notes: No content file was authored. The unit fits the existing magic-item composite family in principle, but requires two surface variants to encode honestly.
